npmIncidentNotice.statement: npm reports that hacktask published deliberate malicious typo-squatted packages on July 19, that crossenv exfiltrated environment variables, and that all hacktask packages were removed.

independentTechnicalAccount.statement: The account lists crossenv@6.1.1 and links its list to npm confirmation.

independentSnykAdvisory.statement: The advisory lists crossenv@6.1.1 as one of the malicious typosquatted packages and says to avoid it.

strictExclusionReason.requiredRule: A primary temporal-ledger record requires a retained official-registry version object selected strictly before the candidate event cutoff so the companion builder can reproduce an exact source snapshot.
strictExclusionReason.observedState: The official registry time map selects crossenv@6.0.7 immediately before the independently reported crossenv@6.1.1 timestamp, but the current bounded response retains only 1.0.0 and 1.0.1 version objects; the selected 6.0.7 object is absent.
strictExclusionReason.consequence: Do not add crossenv to the 14-record primary ledger, do not create a companion source snapshot, direct declarations, range approximations, recursive graph edges, campaign-family count, or validation unit from this candidate.

prohibitedInterpretations: This exclusion does not dispute the independently corroborated crossenv incident evidence or convert the candidate into a benign, safe, unchanged, no-known-event, or control row.
